policy.contentType: Legacy category "News" maps to "news"; every other legacy category maps to the neutral "explainer" placeholder pending editorial review.
policy.topics: No topics are inferred because the legacy source has no structured topic field.
policy.publishedAt: Legacy date-only values use 00:00:00.000Z on the same calendar date; updatedAt is intentionally omitted.
policy.images: Existing remote image URL is preserved in featuredImage.externalUrl; article title is used as alt text to match legacy frontend behavior.
policy.monetization: Migrated articles default to "none" so migration cannot accidentally introduce ads.
policy.relatedArticles: No related-article relationships are inferred during migration.
policy.parsing: H2, H3, bullets, numbered lists, inline strong, Markdown links and valid pipe tables are parsed. Unsupported or malformed syntax is preserved and reported.
